title: Blacksmith hits unicorn valuation after Sequoia leads Series C | TechCrunch
summary: The Series C comes just two months after its $45 million Series B, which valued the company at $550 million. A year ago, Blacksmith was valued at $60 million after raising a $10 million Series A.
